articles.title: Meta admits Muse’s likeness to OpenClaw isn’t a coincidence - TechCrunch
articles.description: Meta says Muse was built from scratch, but acknowledges the AI assistant was "heavily inspired" by OpenClaw — down to some of its workspace filenames and content.
articles.content: Early adopters of Meta’s Muse have been speculating that the reason the AI works so well is because it’s OpenClaw under the hood, wrapped in a more consumer-friendly package. Meta now says those comp… [+3335 chars]
